AiLearningPrompts.PromptForWordTranslatingWithExampleSente: You are a language-learning assistant for English learners whose native language is Ukrainian; analyze a single English word and return ONLY structured JSON in this schema: {'word':'string','partOfSpeech':'string','senses':[{'senseId':1,'definition':'string','ukrainianTranslation':'string','usageLabel':'common|formal|informal','examples':['string',... up to {EXAMPLES_COUNT} strings],'synonyms':['string',... up to 3]}]}, with max 3 senses, only common learner-relevant meanings, each sense must have a sense-specific Ukrainian translation, examples must be simple B1–B2, exactly {EXAMPLES_COUNT} examples per sense, no idioms or phrasal verbs unless the word itself is one, ensure senses and synonyms are clearly distinguishable and non-overlapping, output JSON only, no explanations, markdown, or prose; INPUT: Word: {WORD}
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForCheckingIfWordCompliesToTheTopi: Does the word '{word}' relate to the topic '{topic}'? Respond with a JSON object: {'doesComply': true or false} Ensure the response is valid JSON without any extra text.
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForCheckingIfTranslationsAreCorrec: You are an English–Ukrainian dictionary verification assistant; analyze the array of user-provided translations in 'TranslatedWords' and return ONLY structured JSON in this schema: [{'OriginalWord':'string','TranslatedWord':string|null,'IsCorrect':boolean,'SenseId':'string'}]. You MUST return exactly one output object for EACH input item in TranslatedWords, in the SAME order. OriginalWord MUST be copied from input. TranslatedWord MUST be copied exactly from the user's 'Translated' field (keep it null if the user provided nothing). SenseId MUST be copied exactly from the input item without modification. IsCorrect indicates whether the translation is correct for the meaning described in 'Definition' when translating from OriginalLanguage to TranslatedLanguage using standard English–Ukrainian dictionary rules. If Translated is null, empty, or incorrect, IsCorrect MUST be false. Do NOT include correct translations. Do NOT omit any items. Do NOT explain anything. Output JSON ONLY. INPUT: OriginalLanguage: {OriginalLanguage}, TranslatedLanguage: {TranslatedLanguage}, TranslatedWords: {TranslatedWordsJson}
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForGeneratingSentencesWithGaps: Generate sentences where each sentence contains one of the given words, but the word is replaced with exactly five asterisks (*****). Ensure the sentence provides enough context to guess the missing word. Return the response in this JSON format: [{'sentence': string, 'correctWord': string}]. Here is the array of words: [{words}]. Make sure that the one word gets one sentence
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForGeneratingExampleText: Generate a short, engaging story, dialogue, or article that naturally incorporates the following words: [{words}]. The text should be coherent, meaningful, and demonstrate the correct usage of each word in context. Aim for a balance between variety and clarity so the user can understand how these words are used in real-life situations. Return a json object of next structure: {text: string}. Every word that I gave you put inside *.
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForGeneratingReadingComprehensionE: Create a short English text (100–150 words) using these words: [{words}]. Then generate 3 reading comprehension questions about the text. Return JSON: { "Text": string, "Questions": string[] }.
AiLearningPrompts.PromptForCheckingIfReadingComprehensionE: Given the following text, questions, and user answers, check each answer based on the text. For each, return whether it is correct and what the correct answer is. Then return JSON: { "AnswersCorrect": int, "AnswersResults": [ { "IsCorrect": bool, "CorrectAnswer": string } ] }. Text: {text} Questions: {questions} Answers: {answers}
